title: C26 DOWN-regime fade on DEV: C26 pivot vs Krown dominant lower high as H1, with the pre-registered H2 filters

what.name: Setup
what.value_plain: a held 15m high H1 is taken out in a DOWN regime; short at the first 15m close back under H1, next-bar open (shifted)
what.label: OURS

what.name: H1 set 1
what.value_plain: C26 pivot +-16, pull-back >= 0.8 %, retest within 0.4 % held 4 bars, age <= 72h
what.label: OURS

what.name: H1 set 2
what.value_plain: Krown dominant lower high: the high from which a new low was made (KR-S12, KROWN_SETUP_CATALOG.md line 820)
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: H1 set 2 implementation
what.value_plain: swing high = fractal +-2 (FORMULAS 18.2); new low = below the low H rallied from and a 12-bar record low
what.label: OURS

what.name: DOWN regime
what.value_plain: close before the take-out below the 200-bar mean of 15m closes
what.label: OURS

what.name: Exits
what.value_plain: one stop at H1 + 1.0 %, target = the pull-back low L1, 24h time stop
what.label: OURS

what.name: H2 filters
what.value_plain: F1 StochRSI K >= 80; F2 no CVD up-impulse at the take-out; F3 exit at the first CVD up-impulse in 8 bars; F4 / F4c OI not rising
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10 % per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Base
what.value_plain: same exits on 20 random DOWN-regime entries per event; paired test, Holm over 12 arms; power at Holm-level alpha
what.label: OURS

how: phase3_dev.py on Binance spot BTCUSDT 1m -> 15m, DEV 2022-04-01 .. 2024-06-30 only (VALIDATION and HOLDOUT never loaded); OI from the USDT-M 5m metrics. One distinct position per take-out bar. Re-run: python phase3_dev.py <repo> <cache> --dev 2022-04-01:2024-06-30.

verdict.label: NO on DEV: 0 of 12 arms net above zero after fees, none beats random entries after Holm; underpowered arms (MDE above +0.20 %): c26 6/6, krown 0/6

why: C26 pivot +-16 (OURS) F0: 97 traded, mean net -0.216 %, random-entry base -0.082 %, Holm p 1.000.
Krown dominant lower high (KR-S12) F0: 661 traded, mean net -0.117 %, random-entry base -0.094 %, Holm p 1.000.

C26 pivot +-16 (OURS): MDE (80 % power) 0.27-0.46 % per trade against a design effect of +0.20 %; 0 of 6 arms have a positive mean net; lowest Holm p 1.000; F0 in the UP regime: mean net +0.010 % (n 342).

Krown dominant lower high (KR-S12): MDE (80 % power) 0.09-0.13 % per trade against a design effect of +0.20 %; 0 of 6 arms have a positive mean net; lowest Holm p 1.000; F0 in the UP regime: mean net -0.098 % (n 919).
Power gate first: an arm whose MDE is above the +0.20 % design effect is 'underpowered, no verdict' whatever its p.
